import collections
def comps(fr, colors='cBYW'):
    g = fr.ascii.split('\n')

                m=0; over=0
                for (y,x) in P:

                            else: over += 1

    out=[]

        fa = footprints(A,K,L); fb = footprints(B,K,L)
        best_b = {}
        for (dy,dx,m,o) in fb:

        blist = [(m,v[0],v[1],v[2]) for m,v in best_b.items()]
        for (a1,a2,am,ao) in fa:
            need = FULL & ~am

def cover7b(KLs, maxout=8):
    gg = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')

    def foot(P,K,L):
        res={}
        for dy in range(-8,22):
            for dx in range(-8,23):
                m=0; over=0
                for (y,x) in P:
                    for (yy,xx) in [(y+dy,x+dx),(y+dy,K-x-dx),(L-y-dy,x+dx),(L-y-dy,K-x-dx)]:

    out=[]
    for (K,L) in KLs:
        fa = foot(A,K,L); fb = foot(B,K,L)
        for (am,a1,a2,ao) in fa:
            need = FULL & ~am

    out=[]
    for (K,L) in KLs:
        fa = foot(R1,K,L); fb = foot(R2,K,L)
        maxb = max(m.bit_count() for m,_,_,_ in fb)
        for (am,a1,a2,ao) in fa:
            need = FULL & ~am
            if need.bit_count() > maxb: continue
            for (bm,b1,b2,bo) in fb:

                    out.append((cost, ao+bo, K, L, (a1,a2), (b1,b2)))
                    break
    out.sort()
    return len(out), out[:maxout]
